name: sol_am_dosa_3
description: Denial-of-service from blacklistable tokens blocking required push transfers
question: The source file in `source` performs a required token transfer (such as repayment, distribution, redemption, or withdrawal) by pushing tokens directly to a stored recipient address via transfer/transferFrom, with no pull-based claim mechanism, try/catch isolation, or skip/redirect path for failed transfers, so that if the token (e.g., USDC-style) blacklists that recipient, the transfer reverts and blocks the function for all other unrelated users or for the whole protocol; this excludes cases where the transfer is wrapped in try/catch, uses a low-level call whose failure is tolerated, or always sends to msg.sender.
criteria: repayToCreditor() calls token.transferFrom(borrower, creditor, amount) directly with no try/catch, so a blacklisted creditor blocks every future repayment attempt
distributeRewards() loops over an array of recipients calling token.transfer(recipient, amount) without isolating per-recipient failures, so one blacklisted recipient reverts the entire distribution
withdraw() sends the underlying token to a stored beneficiary via transfer() with no alternative pull/claim path, causing all withdrawals to permanently fail once the beneficiary is blacklisted
closePosition() force-transfers collateral to the position owner's address with no fallback, so a blacklisted owner prevents anyone from closing or liquidating the position
